northline.nota:
**Northline Cyber Advisory**, FIRSTLIGHT's front. “Gray carpet, plastic plants, standing desks, a welcome sign with the logo of a cybersecurity consulting firm” (the logo panel is on the north wall of reception, backlit and with no lettering on the map). “At three in the morning, three lights are burning on the 11th floor. One of them belongs to a conference room with the blinds closed”: the three are the logo panel in reception, the lamp at Hale's station in the open desks, and the fluorescent light in the **conference room**, whose north windows have the blinds drawn (from outside you see the light, not the room).

**Conference room.** The long table and, on the east wall, the **corkboard covered in photos**, Helen's podcast among them. The partition facing the open desks is glass with closed blinds: on the map it's a wall (you can't see in). This is where interlude I-2 “SEA-0411” (SPEC §6) plays out: Okafor and Hale receive ARCHER's delivery (DOC-07).

**Open desks** (the analysts): eight standing desks in two islands. Hale's is the one with the lamp. Okafor “never sits with her back to a door.”

**Restricted area.** From the open desks, a door with a card reader opens onto the hallway to the **locked armory** (lockers of carbines, incendiary ammunition, UV flashlights, vests; at night the tactical team MEN-02 is in a warehouse at the port, not here, so there are gaps) and to the **white “interview” room**: white tile, a table and a chair bolted down, and **high-intensity UV lamps** on the walls. They're off; switched on, every Kindred in their light takes 1 aggravated damage per turn and −2 dice (UV flashlight, FIRSTLIGHT arsenal). The UV lights on the map are marked as off.

**Access.** Elevators and emergency stairs in the floor's shared lobby, south of reception; Northline's glass door is locked at night. Neither has a map of the other end.

**Danger:** “coming in here is the fastest way to raise the Thermometer”: if the intrusion is discovered, Thermometer +3. “It's more useful to watch than to go in.” It doesn't appear in any fixed scene: it's held in reserve for the chronicle, a very bold coterie, and FIRSTLIGHT's interludes (I-2, I-3).
